title: Oak Cellar Wine Man
premise: A long vineyard drama under purple-green trellises and an oak cellar. Xiaohe and Aran look nearly alike and are easily mistaken; the old oak barrel goes intact→leaking→hoop-repaired; the Zixia cart is wrecked and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; entities without use appearance. Flashbacks may set state on a present item.

states.prime_cellarer: Cellar worker Laoteng in his fifties, short gray-white beard, wine-red waistcoat and linen shirt, a tasting pipette at his waist, hands tanned deep brown by oak.
states.waist_injury_cane: The same Laoteng with a waist injury: hard to bend, walking slowly with a hawthorn cane, still in that faded wine-red waistcoat.
states.deceased: Laoteng has closed his eyes and passed away, lying quietly on a narrow cot in the cellar rest room, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Xiaohe: a lean grape-picking apprentice of fifteen, green-vine hairband, light-green work clothes, a grape-leaf badge on the left lapel, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Xiaohe: a broad-shouldered cellar assistant in the twenties, still with green-vine hairband and grape-leaf badge, steady look.

states.aging_intact: A man-tall French old oak barrel branded 'Cuvée 07', iron hoops intact, pale-gold wine tears seeping from the grain.
states.stave_leaking: The same old oak barrel with cracked staves leaking; purple-red wine runs down the cracks, iron hoops loose.
states.hoop_repaired: After stave replacement and re-hooping, the old oak barrel seals again; new wood patches and new iron hoops distinguish it from the first intact state.

states.intact: A brown-leather aging logbook, cover gilt-stamped 'East Slope Estate', pages filled with neat pen notes of barrel dates and tasting notes.
states.wine_stained: The same aging logbook soaked through by spilled red wine, cover swollen and wrinkled, writing bled into purple-red blotches.

states.intact: A deep-purple wooden cart with gold letters 'Zixia' on the sideboards, vine baskets in the bed for hauling clusters.
states.slope_overturned: The deep-purple cart has overturned on the slope; sideboards broken, vine baskets scattered—a wreck that can no longer haul clusters.

states.young_visitor: Young Aran: face nearly identical to Xiaohe's, but wine-red hairband, a tiny wine-cup earring on the right ear, more playful look.
states.adult_sommelier: Adult Aran: face nearly identical to adult Xiaohe's, still wine-red hairband and wine-cup earring, sommelier apron over the shoulder.

E7.name: oak wine cellar
E7.appearance: An underground vaulted oak wine cellar, aging barrels stacked on both sides, wall lamps dim yellow, air rich with oak and wine.

E8.name: trellis slope
E8.appearance: The purple-green trellis slope outside the cellar, grape clusters hanging low, a gravel path winding downhill.

E9.name: press dark corridor
E9.appearance: A narrow dark corridor to the press shop, empty barrels and sulfur fumigators stacked on both sides.

E10.name: abandoned drying shed
E10.appearance: An abandoned drying shed on the slope crest, wooden posts leaning, rusted iron hooks empty.

E11.name: founding bronze plaque
E11.appearance: A founding bronze plaque nailed to the cellar stone lintel, engraved with Laoteng's name and founding year, edges mottled with verdigris.

E12.name: tasting glasses
E12.appearance: Three tulip-shaped tasting glasses, numbered on the stems, neatly upside-down on the tasting table.

E13.name: Chixia motor cart
E13.appearance: A brand-new wine-red electric cluster cart with 'Chixia' sprayed on the door, no Zixia crest, utterly unlike Zixia.

E14.name: Estate advisor Lao Xun
E14.appearance: Estate advisor Lao Xun in his fifties, short gray-white beard and wine-red waistcoat, build close to Laoteng's, but a gold advisor badge on the chest.

E15.name: cellar lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five brass cellar lamps hung on iron hooks under the oak wine cellar vault, shades polished clear.

E16.name: decanting brass bells
E16.appearance: Two decanting brass bells hung at the cellar doorway, grapevine patterns chased on the bodies, chiming lightly when the wind rises.

E17.name: neighbor-garden girl Qingqing
E17.appearance: Neighbor-garden girl Qingqing, fifteen or sixteen, green-vine hairband; at a glance like young Xiaohe, but no grape-leaf badge on the left lapel, shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: spare small barrel
E18.appearance: A half-man-tall spare small oak barrel shaped much like the old oak barrel but shorter, branded 'Trial' not 'Cuvée 07'.

E19.name: gray-brown trailer
E19.appearance: A strange gray-brown farm trailer with empty baskets in the bed, no Zixia lettering anywhere—not the same as Zixia.

features.E2: Xiaohe: green-vine hairband, grape-leaf badge on left lapel.
features.E6: Aran: face nearly identical to Xiaohe's, but wine-red hairband, wine-cup earring on right ear.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard misidentification sample: Xiaohe and Aran look alike; tell them apart only by green-vine/wine-red hairband and badge/earring.

scenes.setting: Oak cellar barrel patrol (introduce five cellar lamps · two decanting bells)
actions: At dusk, Laoteng walks down the stone steps into the oak wine cellar; the old oak barrel ages quietly under the wall lamps.

actions.action: A row of five brass cellar lamps hangs under the oak wine cellar vault; Laoteng polishes each shade.
Two decanting brass bells hang at the cellar doorway; Laoteng reaches to make them chime softly.

actions: Laoteng circles the old oak barrel, checking iron hoops and grain for leaks.
From a vent, Laoteng watches the sky darken outside the cellar.

actions.action: The intact old oak barrel seeps pale-gold wine tears deep in the cellar.

actions: Laoteng sits by the tasting table and dozes briefly by a cellar lamp.
Damp climbs the stone steps; Laoteng buttons his wine-red waistcoat tight.
Laoteng opens the aging logbook and notes that evening's tasting impression.
Laoteng draws an acidity curve in the aging logbook.
Laoteng closes the aging logbook and returns it to the tasting-table drawer.

actions.action: The shadow of the old oak barrel sweeps Laoteng's profile.

actions: Laoteng gently wipes wine traces from the tasting pipette with a soft cloth.

scenes.setting: Trellis slope greets apprentice (introduce three tasting glasses)
actions: On the morning trellis slope, Laoteng greets young Xiaohe pushing deep-purple Zixia in.

actions.action: Xiaohe steadies Zixia and lifts grape clusters from the bed onto the weighing stand.
Laoteng points to the three tasting glasses on the tasting table and teaches Xiaohe to read aroma layers.
Xiaohe crouches by the gravel path, curiously touching the low-hanging grape clusters.
Laoteng points toward the valley and explains to Xiaohe how morning mist affects sugar.
Xiaohe glances back at parked Zixia, eyes full of longing.

actions: They lean side by side on a trellis post, listening to leaves rasp.
In the press dark corridor, Aran in the wine-red hairband turns to look from behind empty barrels.
Aran fiddles with a sulfur fumigator in the corridor; the wine-cup earring glints lightly.
Aran phones a photo of the old vintage chart on the wall and smiles playfully.
Aran carries a sommelier apron through the shadows of the press dark corridor.
Fumigation scent fills the air; Aran stops to hear the press hum overhead.
On the trellis slope, Xiaohe and Aran stand side by side—one green-vine hairband, one wine-red.
Xiaohe hands a tasting glass to Aran; they smile at each other.
Aran smooths Xiaohe's green-vine hairband; they walk slowly along the gravel path.
Xiaohe and Aran part at the west end of the slope, each going the opposite way.
Morning mist rises; the sisters' backs—one green, one red—drift farther apart.
Months later at night, Laoteng patrols the oak wine cellar alone; the old oak barrel ages quietly.

actions.action: Laoteng opens the aging logbook and finds the cover already soaked through by red wine, writing bled into purple-red blotches.

actions: Laoteng wipes wine tears condensed on the old oak barrel's iron hoops.
From a vent, Laoteng looks toward the pitch-dark trellis outside.

actions.action: The outline of the old oak barrel slowly emerges under the cellar lamps.

actions: Laoteng slips the stained aging logbook into a desiccant bag and sighs.

scenes.setting: Wine season turns (filler · stretch the gap)
actions: Seasons turn; Laoteng walks down the stone steps day after day to patrol the oak wine cellar.
Another snowy night, Laoteng pulls the waistcoat tight and keeps watch by the old oak barrel.
At spring pruning, Laoteng checks barrel numbers and vintages in the cellar.
At high summer noon, Laoteng wipes stone seams steamed by heat on the cellar wall.
On the eve of autumn harvest, the old oak barrel's wine scent grows thicker in the damp.
Another New Year's Eve, Laoteng alone keeps the oak wine cellar until dawn.
On the night before a tasting, Laoteng washes the tasting glasses two hours early.
On a full-moon night, Laoteng hangs insect screens on the vents.
When a cold snap hits, Laoteng hangs a thick cotton curtain on the cellar door.
Around Qingming, Laoteng sweeps fallen leaves and broken twigs on the trellis slope.
For three rainless nights running, Laoteng logs barrel temperatures densely.
One night humidity spikes; Laoteng half-opens a vent to vent damp.
The wine scent shifts; Laoteng quickly samples for comparison.
At three in the morning, Laoteng drinks cold tea from a thermos.
By the tasting table he sorts the tasting-glass numbers.
A decanting bell chimes lightly in the wind; Laoteng looks up to listen.
As the sky pales, Laoteng notes last night's final tasting notes.
Before locking the cellar door, he glances once more at the old oak barrel's intact iron hoops.

scenes.setting: Trellis patrol (recall tasting glasses · gray-brown trailer)
actions: At dawn, Laoteng patrols the trellis slope; deep-purple Zixia waits by the weighing stand.

actions.action: Laoteng crouches to check Zixia's wheels and vine-basket lashings.
Laoteng walks to the tasting table; those earlier three tasting glasses still sit neatly upside-down.
A strange gray-brown trailer rolls down the slope—empty baskets in the bed, not Zixia.
On the gravel path, Laoteng logs last night's humidity peak.
Laoteng re-covers the low-hanging grape clusters with bird netting.

actions: Far morning mist clears, revealing deeper valley shadow.
A storm breaks; the oak wine cellar frets with seepage sounds; the old oak barrel rocks hard.
Standing water climbs the stone steps; Laoteng rushes to the drain gate.

actions.action: A dull crack—the old oak barrel's staves split and leak; purple-red wine runs down.
On the slope, deep-purple Zixia jolts hard through the mud.
A sideslip overturns Zixia; sideboards break, vine baskets scatter.
In the cellar, Laoteng lunges at the old oak barrel and clamps the loose iron hoop.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Zixia old-photo indirect reference · cellar-lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm, Laoteng stands in the oak wine cellar staring at the leaking old oak barrel.
Laoteng brushes the stave crack with a finger, face dark.
On a sticky note beside the aging logbook, Laoteng records the date Zixia overturned.
An old photo of Zixia hangs on the cellar wall; Laoteng gazes a long while.
Laoteng takes one of the five brass cellar lamps from the wall and sits alone in the faint light.
The damaged old oak barrel still stands cracked at the cellar center.

scenes.setting: Hoop repaired (third state · spare-small-barrel false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Laoteng brings staves and new iron hoops and begins repairing the old oak barrel.

actions.action: From a wood crate Laoteng takes out a spare small barrel—much like the old oak barrel but shorter.

actions: Laoteng carefully replaces staves, tightens hoops, and reseals with wax.

actions.action: The last iron hoop is driven home; the old oak barrel enters its hoop-repaired state.

actions: The repaired old oak barrel seals again; Laoteng looks on with relief.

scenes.setting: False friends: Chixia motor cart and estate advisor Lao Xun

actions.action: A wine-red Chixia motor cart drives onto the trellis slope—nothing like the overturned Zixia.
Estate advisor Lao Xun walks onto the slope and talks beside Laoteng; the two builds are alike.
Lao Xun points at the Chixia motor cart to explain the new cluster-haul roster to Laoteng.
The Chixia motor cart drives off; Laoteng alone watches it go from the trellis slope.

actions: Wind flaps the roster sheet Lao Xun left behind.

scenes.setting: False friend: neighbor-garden girl Qingqing who resembles Xiaohe

actions.action: Downslope comes neighbor-garden girl Qingqing in a green-vine hairband; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Xiaohe.
Qingqing practices cutting clusters; Laoteng shakes his head—she is not Xiaohe after all.
Qingqing leaves the trellis slope with an empty basket; her back fades down the gravel path.
Years later at dusk, Laoteng who can barely bend leans on a hawthorn cane outside the oak wine cellar stone door.

actions: Laoteng leans on the cane and looks up at the vaulted stone lintel, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two decanting brass bells at the doorway chime lightly in the wind; cane-leaning Laoteng stops to listen.

actions: Cane in hand, Laoteng sets a palm on the cellar's cold stone wall, as if saying goodbye.
He slowly sits on the stone steps, cane resting by his knee.

actions.action: By day, adult Xiaohe returns along the gravel path and hurries toward the oak wine cellar.

actions: Outside the stone door Xiaohe reunites with cane-leaning Laoteng; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the rest-room narrow cot, Xiaohe holds Laoteng's deep-brown but icy hand.
Laoteng's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and quietly passes away.
Xiaohe gently sets Laoteng's tasting pipette back by the pillow.
Behind the cellar door Laoteng's wine-red waistcoat still hangs; Xiaohe reaches to stroke it gently.
By the stone lintel, adult Xiaohe stands before a newly nailed founding bronze plaque.
Xiaohe's fingertip traces Laoteng's name carved on the founding bronze plaque.

actions: Wind rises; a decanting bell chimes far off; Xiaohe lifts her head.

actions.action: Adult Aran arrives from the neighboring estate and tightly embraces Xiaohe outside the stone door.

actions: Xiaohe and Aran stand side by side by the lintel—one quiet, one playful.
They look at each other in silence, at faces alike and yet unlike.
Aran unties the sommelier apron, then silently ties it back, only standing with her sister.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth touching grape clusters by the gravel path appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth touching grape clusters by the gravel path

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the cellar, an oak barrel branded with a vintage seeps wine tears for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the oak barrel that first seeped wine tears at the opening

actions.action: Flashback to the press dark corridor that year—the figure in a wine-red hairband with a wine-cup earring flashes past.

anchor.phrase: the figure in a wine-red hairband in the dark corridor that year

actions.action: Again that row of five old brass wall lamps under the vault.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old brass cellar lamps under the vault

actions.action: Back to that purple-green grape-trellis slope of first meeting; gravel winds as before.

anchor.phrase: that purple-green trellis slope of first meeting

actions.action: Xiaohe reopens that wine-stained aging logbook and walks into the oak wine cellar.
On the tasting table, those earlier three tasting glasses still sit neatly upside-down.
Xiaohe takes over patrol of the old oak barrel; wine scent climbs the stone steps again.

actions: Outside the vent, the trellis outline slowly clears in morning light.
